newsitem.title: UK: KEPIT defends fund plans against TREG.
newsitem.headline: KEPIT defends fund plans against TREG.

text.p: Kleinwort European Privatisation Investment Trust (KEPIT) on Wednesday responded to criticisms of the proposals it put forward yesterday by TR European Growth Trust Plc (TREG), which has made a hostile bid for the fund.

KEPIT said it strongly rejected "TREG's allegation that KEPIT's recommended proposal unfairly favours KEPIT investors who elect to retain an investment over those who elect to realise their investment for cash".
It said the plans did not involved "cherry picking" and that its proposals "should lead to a higher value being realised than under TREG's offers".
KEPIT also said there would be no initial charges on transfers into the successor unit trusts.
